meta.source: OPERA Land Surface Disturbance Alert from Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2, Version 1 (OPERA_L3_DIST-ALERT-HLS_V1), NASA JPL OPERA project, distributed by NASA LP DAAC. Forest from ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 (tree cover).
meta.definition: Confirmed vegetation loss (status confirmed, ongoing or finished) on 30 m pixels that are tree cover in ESA WorldCover 2021, by the month loss was first detected.
